title: Crash & Startup Health
objective: Mendeteksi crash loop, startup failure, project-open failure, dan recovery behavior.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan lima sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; crash_rate ok sementara crash_loop failed = FAIL crash_loop_ignored; startup_failure failed sementara recovery_success failed = FAIL startup_unrecovered; project_open_failure failed sementara recovery_success failed = FAIL project_open_unrecovered; crash_loop failed sementara recovery_success failed = FAIL crash_loop_unrecovered; kegagalan yang pulih jujur (recovery_success recovered/ok tanpa pelanggaran) = PASS konsistensi; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; belum ada telemetri crash atau startup produksi yang diamati.
Sesi startup/project-open native GUI, restart perangkat keras, kanal update end-user, dan publikasi distribusi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
